-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local EnemyView = require('abyss_battle_enemy_view')
local DamageView = require('abyss_battle_damage_view')
local PotionView = require("abyss_battle_potion_view")
local IntentView = require("abyss_battle_intent_view")
local RewardOwner = require("abyss_battle_reward_owner")
local LowCostArt=require('abyss_lowcost_art')
local M = {}
local C, L, S = Theme.color, Theme.layout, Theme.space
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local potionText = PotionView.potionText
local intentView = IntentView.intentView
-- Last successful geometry writer per native handle; tokens hold no view references.
local intentSizes=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
local intentPositions=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
local function intentSize(control,width,height,owner)
    local painted=intentSizes[control]
    if painted and painted.owner==owner and painted.width==width
        and painted.height==height and control.alive~=false then return end
    -- Revoke the old promise before a setter can partially apply or re-enter.
    local pending={};intentSizes[control]=pending
    local ok,result=pcall(control.SetSizeDelta,control,width,height)
    local current=intentSizes[control]==pending
    intentSizes[control]=nil
    if not ok then error(result,0) end
    if result~=false and current then intentSizes[control]={owner=owner,width=width,height=height} end
end
local function intentPosition(control,x,y,owner)
    local painted=intentPositions[control]
    if painted and painted.owner==owner and painted.x==x
        and painted.y==y and control.alive~=false then return end
    local pending={};intentPositions[control]=pending
    local ok,result=pcall(control.SetAnchoredPosition,control,x,y)
    local current=intentPositions[control]==pending
    intentPositions[control]=nil
    if not ok then error(result,0) end
    -- Overlapping native setters have unknown completion order: retry next time.
    if result~=false and current then intentPositions[control]={owner=owner,x=x,y=y} end
end
-- Only the six intent controls have exclusive visibility writers in this module.
-- Name visibility is also owned by UnitView, so it is deliberately not cached.
local intentVisibilities=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
local function intentVisible(control,value,binding)
    local saved=intentVisibilities[control]
    if saved and saved.binding==binding and saved.value==value and control.alive~=false then return end
    local pending={};intentVisibilities[control]=pending
    local ok,accepted=pcall(control.SetVisible,control,value)
    local ownsWrite=intentVisibilities[control]==pending
    intentVisibilities[control]=nil
    if not ok then error(accepted,0) end
    if accepted~=false and ownsWrite then intentVisibilities[control]={binding=binding,value=value} end
end
local function needsTarget(state, instance)
    -- Ask the core to validate the same card with and without a target.
    local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(state, instance.uid, nil)
    return reason == "invalid_target"
end
local function aimsAtAllEnemies(battle,uid)
    for _,instance in ipairs(battle.hand) do
        if instance.uid==uid then return Combat.cardDefinition(battle,instance).target=='ALL_ENEMY' end
    end
    return false
end
local function enemyPortraitIcon(enemy)
    return Theme.icon.enemy[enemy.definitionId] or Theme.icon.node[enemy.tier == 'normal' and 'combat' or enemy.tier]
end
local function paintEnemyArt(host,box,enemy,x,y,portrait,tone,dim)
    local icon=box:GetChild('portrait')
    if host.monsterArt:write(box,x,y,portrait,tone)then LowCostArt.hide(icon,false);return end
    LowCostArt.paint(icon,'enemy',enemy.definitionId,portrait,host.platform)
    LowCostArt.dim(icon,dim and .4 or 1)
    LowCostArt.refresh(box,{r=tone.r,g=tone.g,b=tone.b,a=255})
end
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, ownership, host, dependencies)
    -- A new view binding starts fresh; weak native keys cannot retain retired actors.
    local intentGeometryOwner={}
    local intentImages=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local intentTexts=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local potionCaptions=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local function intentPicture(control,id)
        local image=type(id)=='table' and id.id or id
        local source=host.platform.imageSource
        local painted=intentImages[control]
        if painted and painted.image==image and painted.source==source and control.alive~=false then return end
        intentImages[control]=nil
        if dependencies.picture(control,id)~=false then intentImages[control]={image=image,source=source} end
    end
    local function pendingCardTarget(frame)
        if not frame.fighting or not owner.selected then return false end
        for _, instance in ipairs(frame.battle.hand) do
            if instance.uid == owner.selected then return needsTarget(frame.battle, instance) end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function potionHighlighted(enemy, index, pendingTarget)
        local aim = owner.potionAim
        if not aim or pendingTarget or not Actors.isActive(enemy) then return false end
        if aim.moving then
            local valid, hovered = dependencies.potionDragTarget(aim)
            return valid and hovered == index
        end
        -- Point selection advertises every legal enemy; a moving bottle locks
        -- only the hovered target through potionDragTarget above.
        return true
    end
    local function enemyHighlighted(frame, enemy, index, pendingTarget)
        local targetable = frame.active and pendingTarget and Combat.canPlay(frame.battle, owner.selected, index)
        if owner.gesture and owner.gesture.moving then
            local valid, hovered = dependencies.dragTarget(owner.gesture)
            targetable = valid and hovered == index
        end
        return targetable == true or potionHighlighted(enemy,index,pendingTarget) or owner.acting == enemy.id
    end
    local function enemyIntentFace(frame,enemy,index)
        local face
        if IntentView.hasSourceIntent(enemy)then
            local view=host.monsterIntentParticles
            local selected=view:needsSelected(enemy.id) and IntentView.selectedDescriptor(frame.battle,index) or nil
            face=view:face(enemy.id,selected,function(base)
                return Combat.intentAttackAmount(frame.battle,enemy,frame.battle.player,base)
            end)
        else face=intentView(frame.battle,index)end
        -- Dome changes visibility, never the source selected/displayed state.
        if require('abyss_boss_relics').hidesIntents(owner.run)then face.hidden=true;face.value=''end
        return face
    end
    local function intentGeometry(portrait,geometry)
        if geometry then return geometry.intentX,geometry.intentY,geometry.intentWidth end
        return 0,portrait/2,128*Theme.canvas.base[1]/1920
    end
    local function intentTone(alpha,kind)
        -- STS intent atlases are colour-coded (attack red, defend blue, buff gold,
        -- debuff violet); white-tinted silhouettes read as one undifferentiated blob.
        local ink=({attack=C.danger,defend=C.block,buff=C.buff,debuff=C.debuff,strong_debuff=C.debuff})[kind] or C.text
        return {r=ink.r,g=ink.g,b=ink.b,a=255*(alpha or 1)}
    end
    local function renderIntentIcon(box,face,x,y,size,allowed,alpha)
        local kind=face.worldKind or face.kind
        local visible=allowed~=false and (face.sourceEnum and face.worldVisible or not face.sourceEnum)
        local icon=box:GetChild('intentIcon');intentVisible(icon,visible==true,intentGeometryOwner)
        -- STS 128px intent frames are mostly transparent padding; the official glyphs here
        -- are full-bleed, so draw them at the glyph size and float them clear of the head.
        local glyph=math.min(size,L.intent.size)
        intentSize(icon,glyph,glyph,intentGeometryOwner);intentPosition(icon,x,y,intentGeometryOwner)
        if visible then
            intentPicture(icon,Theme.icon.intent[kind] or Theme.icon.intent.unknown)
            dependencies.tint(icon,intentTone(alpha,kind))
        end
    end
    local function renderIntentValue(box,face,x,y,allowed,alpha)
        local kind=face.worldKind or face.kind
        local value=box:GetChild('intent')
        local attack=face.sourceEnum and face.sourceEnum:sub(1,6)=='ATTACK' or not face.sourceEnum and kind=='attack'
        intentVisible(value,allowed~=false and attack and face.value~='',intentGeometryOwner)
        local text=face.value and face.value:gsub('×','x') or ''
        if intentTexts[value]~=text or value.alive==false then
            intentTexts[value]=nil
            value.text=text
            intentTexts[value]=text
        end
        local width=math.max(L.intent.valueWidth,utf8.len(text)*L.intent.numberSize)
        intentSize(value,width,L.nativeText.lineHeight,intentGeometryOwner)
        intentPosition(value,x+L.intent.size/2+S.xs+width/2,y,intentGeometryOwner)
        dependencies.ink(value,intentTone(alpha))
    end
    local function renderEnemyIntent(box,face,portrait,geometry,allowed,alpha)
        local x,y,size=intentGeometry(portrait,geometry)
        renderIntentIcon(box,face,x,y,size,allowed,alpha)
        for _,name in ipairs({'intentBadge','intentExtra','intentLabel'})do intentVisible(box:GetChild(name),false,intentGeometryOwner)end
        renderIntentValue(box,face,x,y,allowed,alpha)
        local sx,sy=Theme.canvas.base[1]/1920,Theme.canvas.base[2]/1080
        local hit=box:GetChild('intentHit');intentVisible(hit,allowed~=false,intentGeometryOwner)
        intentPosition(hit,x,y,intentGeometryOwner);intentSize(hit,64*sx,64*sy,intentGeometryOwner)
    end
    local function enemyIntentAllowed(actor,battle)
        return not require('abyss_boss_relics').hidesIntents(owner.run) and Actors.isPresent(actor) and not owner.feedback.dying[actor.id]
            and not owner.feedback.escaping[actor.id] and battle.player.hp>0
    end
    local function enemyAimProjection(frame)
        local aimed = owner.gesture or owner.carry
        local projection = { pendingTarget = pendingCardTarget(frame) }
        if aimed and aimed.moving then projection.valid, projection.target = dependencies.dragTarget(aimed) end
        -- Original targeting updates card damage, not future enemy HP. Keep the
        -- legacy preview outside this profile; cloning and playing a detached
        -- battle on pointer input is both unnecessary and expensive here.
        local futureHp = Theme.presentationProfile ~= 'official-assets-first'
        if projection.valid and not futureHp then projection.allEnemies=aimsAtAllEnemies(frame.battle,aimed.uid) end
        if projection.valid and futureHp then projection.losses = DamageView.preview(frame.battle, aimed.uid, projection.target) end
        local potion=owner.potionAim
        if potion and potion.moving then
            projection.valid,projection.target=dependencies.potionDragTarget(potion)
            if projection.valid and futureHp then projection.losses=DamageView.potionPreview(owner.run,potion.slot,projection.target) end
        end
        return projection
    end
    local function renderDamagePreview(box, enemy, portrait, width, loss)
        local preview = box:GetChild('damagePreview')
        preview:SetVisible(loss ~= nil and loss.loss > 0)
        preview:SetAnchoredPosition(0, -portrait / 2 - S.xxl + L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        preview:SetSizeDelta(width, L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        preview.text = loss and loss.loss > 0 and (loss.hp <= 0 and '击杀' or '−' .. number(loss.loss)) or ''
        if loss and loss.loss > 0 then box:GetChild('hpFill').fillAmount = math.max(0, loss.hp / enemy.maxHp) end
    end
    local function renderEnemySlot(frame, box, entry, slot, count, aim)
        local enemy = entry.actor
        local x, width, portrait, step, y = dependencies.enemySlot(count, slot, enemy)
        box:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y)
        local selected = enemyHighlighted(frame, enemy, entry.index, aim.pendingTarget)
            or aim.allEnemies==true and Actors.isActive(enemy)
        local loss = aim.losses and aim.losses[entry.index]
        if aim.valid and not aim.target and loss and loss.loss > 0 then selected = true end
        local geometry=EnemyView.geometry(enemy)
        host.unit(box, enemy, portrait, enemyPortraitIcon(enemy), width, selected,step,geometry)
        host.monsterPowers:render(box,entry.controlSlot,enemy,geometry)
        box:GetChild('hit'):SetSizeDelta(geometry.hitWidth,geometry.hitHeight)
        box:GetChild('hit'):SetAnchoredPosition(geometry.hitX-x,geometry.hitY-y)
        local dim = (aim.pendingTarget or owner.potionAim ~= nil) and not selected
        local portraitTone = C.text
        local tone={r=portraitTone.r,g=portraitTone.g,b=portraitTone.b,a=dim and 102 or 255}
        dependencies.tint(box:GetChild('portrait'),tone)
        paintEnemyArt(host,box,enemy,x,y,portrait,tone,dim)
        renderDamagePreview(box, enemy, portrait, width, loss)
        renderEnemyIntent(box, enemyIntentFace(frame, enemy, entry.index), portrait,geometry,
            enemyIntentAllowed(enemy,frame.battle),host.monsterIntentParticles:alpha(enemy.id))
        host.monsterIntentParticles:paint(box,enemy.id,geometry,enemyIntentAllowed(enemy,frame.battle))
    end
    local function updateEnemyIntents(dt)
        local battle=owner.displayBattle or owner.run and owner.run.combat
        if not battle or not owner.active then return end
        -- The surface manager owns live handles. Feedback rows may still include
        -- a death whose independently clocked surface has already retired.
        for _,entry in ipairs(owner.feedback.enemyRows or {})do
            local actor=entry.actor
            local box=host.monsterSurfaces:find(entry.id)
            if box then
            local face=enemyIntentFace({battle=battle,enemyPlayback=owner.feedback.busy},actor,entry.index)
            local g=EnemyView.geometry(actor)
            local dying,escaping=owner.feedback.dying[entry.id],owner.feedback.escaping[entry.id]
            host.monsterIntentParticles:update(entry.id,dt,face,g,dying,escaping)
            renderEnemyIntent(box,face,g.portrait,g,enemyIntentAllowed(actor,battle),
                host.monsterIntentParticles:alpha(entry.id))
            host.monsterIntentParticles:paint(box,entry.id,g,enemyIntentAllowed(actor,battle) and face.sourceEnum~='NONE')
            else
                assert(not Actors.isPresent(actor),'active monster intent surface missing: '..entry.id)
            end
        end
    end
    local function nameBlocked(actor)
        if owner.feedback.dying[actor.id] or owner.feedback.escaping[actor.id] then return true end
        if not owner.gesture then return false end
        local battle=owner.run and owner.run.combat
        for _,card in ipairs(battle and battle.hand or {})do
            if card.uid==owner.selected then return not needsTarget(battle,card)end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function updateEnemyNames(dt)
        local battle=owner.run and owner.run.combat
        if ownership.nameBattle~=battle or not ownership.nameStates then ownership.nameBattle=battle;ownership.nameStates={}end
        local x,y
        if host.platform.cursorPosition then x,y=dependencies.point({GetUIPos=host.platform.cursorPosition})end
        local wanted={}
        host.monsterSurfaces:each(function(box,_,entry)
            local id,actor=entry.id,entry.actor;wanted[id]=true
            local state=ownership.nameStates[id] or {timer=0,alpha=0}
            ownership.nameStates[id]=state
            local g=EnemyView.geometry(actor)
            local hovered=x and y and math.abs(x-g.hitX)<g.hitWidth/2 and math.abs(y-g.hitY)<g.hitHeight/2
            local offset
            state.timer,state.alpha,offset=EnemyView.nameStep(state.timer,state.alpha,dt,hovered,nameBlocked(actor),1)
            local name=box:GetChild('name');name:SetVisible(owner.active and offset~=nil and state.alpha>0)
            if offset then
                name:SetAnchoredPosition(g.nameX-(box:GetChild('portrait').x or 0),g.nameY+offset*g.sourceScale)
                dependencies.ink(name,{r=C.gold.r,g=C.gold.g,b=C.gold.b,a=math.floor(255*state.alpha)})
            end
        end)
        for id in pairs(ownership.nameStates)do if not wanted[id]then ownership.nameStates[id]=nil end end
    end
    local function hideEscapingHud(box,id)
        if not owner.feedback.escaping[id] then return end
        for _,name in ipairs({'hpBorder','hpTrack','hpGhost','hpFill','hp','blockEdge','blockIcon','block','name','statusRow','intentIcon','intentBadge','intentExtra','intent','intentHit'})do
            local control=box:GetChild(name)
            intentVisibilities[control]=nil
            local ok,why=pcall(control.SetVisible,control,false)
            intentVisibilities[control]=nil
            if not ok then error(why,0) end
        end
    end
    local function suspendEnemies(rows)
        local ok,why=pcall(function()
            host.monsterSurfaces:select(rows,owner.run.combat)
            host.monsterArt:select(rows)
            host.monsterSurfaces:each(function(box)
                assert(box:SetVisible(false)~=false,'suspended monster visibility rejected')
                host.monsterIntentParticles:release(box)
            end)
        end)
        if not ok then
            local cleaned,reason=pcall(owner.releaseMonsterSurfaces,owner)
            error(tostring(why)..(cleaned and '' or '; cleanup: '..tostring(reason)))
        end
    end
    local function canSuspendEnemies(frame)
        return not owner.active and frame.fighting and owner.run and owner.run.phase=='combat'
            and owner.suspendedBattle==owner.run.combat and host.monsterSurfaces.battle==owner.run.combat
    end
    local function renderEnemies(frame)
        local rows = frame.fighting and EnemyView.slots(frame.battle, owner.feedback) or {}
        local suspended=canSuspendEnemies(frame)
        local retained=rows
        if not owner.active then rows={}end
        host.monsterIntentParticles:sync(rows,owner.run and owner.run.combat,owner.feedback.current,owner.active and frame.fighting)
        if suspended then owner.feedback.enemyRows={};suspendEnemies(retained);return end
        host.monsterSurfaces:select(rows,owner.run and owner.run.combat)
        owner.feedback.enemyRows = rows
        local aim = enemyAimProjection(frame)
        for _,entry in ipairs(rows)do owner.feedback.bindEnemySlot(entry.controlSlot,entry.id)end
        host.monsterArt:select(rows)
        for index,entry in ipairs(rows)do
            local box=assert(host.monsterSurfaces:find(entry.id))
            renderEnemySlot(frame,box,entry,index,#rows,aim)
            hideEscapingHud(box,entry.id)
            box:SetVisible(true)
        end
        updateEnemyNames(0)
    end
    local function renderDetails(frame)
        local reward=owner.info and owner.info.reward and RewardOwner.ready(owner,owner.info.reward)
        if owner.info and (not owner.active or owner.busy or owner.gesture or not frame.fighting and not reward
            or owner.info.battle ~= frame.run.combat) then owner.info = nil end
        host.renderInfo(frame.battle or reward and frame.run.combat)
    end
    local function renderRewardActions(frame)
        local run, stolen = frame.run, frame.stolen
        dependencies.button("skip", owner.active and frame.picking == true and not run.rewards.cardResolved and not owner.busy, false, "跳过")
        dependencies.button("stolenGold", owner.active and stolen and not stolen.claimed and not owner.busy, false,
            stolen and (stolen.claimed and "已取回失金 " or "取回失金 ") .. number(stolen.amount) or "取回失金")
    end
    local function renderContinue(frame)
        local run = frame.run
        dependencies.button("continue", owner.active and run and (frame.manual or run.phase == "map") and not owner.busy, true,
            frame.manual and "前往地图" or "再战一场")
    end
    local function bindPotionSlots(frame)
        if frame.fighting and not owner.busy then
            owner.potionBattle, owner.potionRun, owner.potionSlots = frame.battle, frame.run, {}
            for slot = 1, frame.potionCapacity do
                local id = frame.run.potions[slot]
                if id then owner.potionSlots[slot] = {slot = slot, id = id} end
            end
        end
    end
    local function boundPotion(frame, index)
        local binding = owner.potionSlots and owner.potionSlots[index]
        local item = binding and frame.potions[binding.slot]
        if item and item.id ~= binding.id then return nil end
        return item
    end
    local function potionSelected(slot)
        return owner.potionMenu and owner.potionMenu.slot==slot
            or owner.potionAim and owner.potionAim.slot==slot
    end
    local function paintPotionContents(face,item,tones)
        local bottle=face:GetChild('bottle');bottle:SetVisible(item~=nil)
        face:GetChild('label'):SetVisible(false)
        if item then
            dependencies.picture(bottle,Theme.icon.potion[item.id] or Theme.icon.intent.unknown)
            dependencies.tint(bottle,(Theme.icon.potionTint or {})[item.id]
                or (item.id=='fire_potion' and tones.fire.ink or tones.normal.ink))
        end
    end
    local function paintPotionShell(slot,item)
        local selected=item~=nil and potionSelected(slot)==true
        local tones=C.potionShell
        for _,state in ipairs({'normal','hover','pressed','disabled'})do
            local face=dependencies.child('potion'..slot):GetChild(state)
            face:GetChild('emptyShell'):SetVisible(item==nil)
            face:GetChild('filledShell'):SetVisible(item~=nil and item.id~='fire_potion')
            face:GetChild('fireShell'):SetVisible(item~=nil and item.id=='fire_potion')
            face:GetChild('selectedShell'):SetVisible(selected)
            dependencies.tint(face:GetChild('filledShell'):GetChild('rim'),selected and tones.selected.border or tones.normal.border)
            dependencies.tint(face:GetChild('fireShell'):GetChild('rim'),selected and tones.selected.border or tones.fire.border)
            paintPotionContents(face,item,tones)
        end
    end
    local function paintPotionCaption(slot,item,visible)
        local caption=dependencies.child('potionCaption'..slot)
        local original=Theme.presentationProfile=='official-assets-first'
        local shown=not original and visible==true and item~=nil
        local text=not original and item and PotionView.slotLabel(item)or ''
        local prior=potionCaptions[caption]
        if not prior or prior.shown~=shown or prior.text~=text then
            potionCaptions[caption]=nil
            local accepted=true
            if not prior or prior.shown~=shown then accepted=caption:SetVisible(shown)~=false end
            if not prior or prior.text~=text then caption.text=text end
            if accepted then potionCaptions[caption]={shown=shown,text=text} end
        end
    end
    local function renderPotions(frame)
        -- Fixed physical slots prevent a queued second click moving to another item.
        bindPotionSlots(frame)
        for i = 1, L.battlePotions.count do
            local visible = frame.fighting and i <= frame.potionCapacity
            dependencies.show("potion" .. i, visible)
            local item = boundPotion(frame, i)
            dependencies.button("potion" .. i, visible and frame.active and item ~= nil, false,
                item and potionText(item, frame.battle) or "空药水槽")
            dependencies.show("potionHelp" .. i, false)
            dependencies.button("potionHelp" .. i, visible and frame.active and item ~= nil, false, "")
            paintPotionCaption(i,item,visible)
            paintPotionShell(i,item)
        end
    end

    return {
        updateEnemyNames=updateEnemyNames, updateEnemyIntents=updateEnemyIntents, pendingCardTarget=pendingCardTarget, enemyHighlighted=enemyHighlighted, enemyIntentFace=enemyIntentFace, renderEnemyIntent=renderEnemyIntent, enemyAimProjection=enemyAimProjection,
        renderDamagePreview=renderDamagePreview, enemyPortraitIcon=enemyPortraitIcon, renderEnemySlot=renderEnemySlot, renderEnemies=renderEnemies, renderDetails=renderDetails,
        renderRewardActions=renderRewardActions, renderContinue=renderContinue, bindPotionSlots=bindPotionSlots, boundPotion=boundPotion, renderPotions=renderPotions,
        potionSelected=potionSelected, paintPotionShell=paintPotionShell
    }
end
return M

-- Preserve the approved ordinary list; expand only independent multi-item rows.
local Theme=require('abyss_theme')
local RelicView=require('abyss_relic_view_ui')
local M={}
local rowFaces=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
local names={'goldReward','stolenGold','relicReward1','relicReward2','emeraldKeyReward','claimPotion','cardReward'}
local rowNames={};for _,name in ipairs(names)do rowNames[name]=true end
local function iconId(value)return type(value)=='table'and value.id or value end
local function rewardIcon(name,run)
 if name=='goldReward'or name=='stolenGold'then return iconId(Theme.icon.gold)end
 if name=='cardReward'then return iconId(Theme.icon.deck)end
 if name=='emeraldKeyReward'then return iconId(Theme.icon.lock)end
 local rewards=run and run.rewards
 if name=='claimPotion'then return Theme.icon.potion[rewards and rewards.potion and rewards.potion.id]or Theme.icon.potion.empty end
 local index=tonumber(name:match('^relicReward(%d)$'))
 local item=rewards and rewards.relics and rewards.relics[index]
 return item and RelicView.icon(item.sourceId or item.id,true)or iconId(Theme.icon.node.treasure)
end
local function paintIcon(cached,name,run,platform)
 local id=rewardIcon(name,run)
 if platform.imageSource and cached.id~=id then cached.icon:SetImage(platform.imageSource,id);cached.id=id end
end
function M.paintButton(name,part,state,run,platform,tint,ink)
 local token=Theme.officialAssets and Theme.officialAssets.rewardRows
 if Theme.presentationProfile~='official-assets-first'or not token then return false end
 if name=='continue'then ink(part:GetChild('label'),state=='disabled'and Theme.color.textMuted or token.ink);return true end
 if not rowNames[name]then return false end
 local cached=rowFaces[part]
 if not cached then
  cached={parts=part:GetChild('stsRewardFace'):GetChildren(),icon=part:GetChild('rewardIcon')};rowFaces[part]=cached
 end
 local tone=token[state]or token.normal
 if cached.tone~=tone then for _,image in ipairs(cached.parts)do tint(image,tone)end;cached.tone=tone end
 ink(part:GetChild('label'),state=='disabled'and Theme.color.textMuted or token.ink)
 paintIcon(cached,name,run,platform)
 return true
end
-- Last successful size writer per native handle; owner tokens hold no view references.
local sizes=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
local function size(control,width,height,owner)
 local painted=sizes[control]
 if owner and painted and painted.owner==owner and painted.width==width
  and painted.height==height and control.alive~=false then return end
 -- Revoke both promises when native setters overlap in either completion order.
 local pending={};sizes[control]=pending
 local ok,result=pcall(control.SetSizeDelta,control,width,height)
 local current=sizes[control]==pending
 sizes[control]=nil
 if not ok then error(result,0)end
 if result~=false and current and owner then
  sizes[control]={owner=owner,width=width,height=height}
 end
end
local function visibleRewards(frame)
 local run=frame.run
 local rewards=frame.listing and run.rewards
 local visible={goldReward=rewards and not rewards.goldClaimed,stolenGold=frame.stolen and not frame.stolen.claimed,
  emeraldKeyReward=rewards and rewards.emeraldKey and not rewards.emeraldKey.claimed,
  claimPotion=frame.pendingPotion,cardReward=rewards and not rewards.cardResolved}
 for i=1,2 do
  local item=rewards and rewards.relics and rewards.relics[i]
  visible['relicReward'..i]=item and not item.claimed
 end
 return visible
end
local function positionHost(box,layout)
 -- The shared approved reward host follows the existing ordinary/expanded
 -- layout; its opaque field stays below the battle bar in canvas coordinates.
 if Theme.presentationProfile~='v25-reference'
  and Theme.presentationProfile~='official-assets-first' then return end
 local stage=layout.stage
 local field=box:GetChild('v25RewardField')
 if field then field:SetAnchoredPosition(-stage[1],-stage[2])end
 local paper=box:GetChild('v25RewardPaper')

 if Theme.presentationProfile=='official-assets-first'and Theme.officialAssets.rewardRows then
  local token=Theme.officialAssets.rewardRows
  local panel=box:GetChild('stsRewardPanel')
  panel:SetAnchoredPosition(token.panelPosition[1]-stage[1],token.panelPosition[2]-stage[2])
  local height=token.panelSize[2]+stage[4]-Theme.layout.battleRewards.stage[4]
  panel:SetLocalScale(1,height/token.panelSize[2],1)
 end
end
function M.render(frame,child,sizeOwner)
 local visible=visibleRewards(frame)
 local count=0;for _,name in ipairs(names)do if visible[name]then count=count+1 end end
 local base=Theme.layout.battleRewards
 local layout=count>4 and base.expanded or base
 local box=child('rewardList');local stage=layout.stage
 box:SetAnchoredPosition(stage[1],stage[2]);size(box,stage[3],stage[4],sizeOwner)
 positionHost(box,layout)
 size(box:GetChild('border'),stage[3],stage[4],sizeOwner)
 size(box:GetChild('plate'),stage[3]-Theme.space.border*2,stage[4]-Theme.space.border*2,sizeOwner)
 for _,name in ipairs({'title','subtitle'})do
  local position=layout[name];local control=box:GetChild(name)
  control:SetAnchoredPosition(position[1]-stage[1],position[2]-stage[2])
  size(control,position[3],position[4],sizeOwner)
 end
 local row=0
 for _,name in ipairs(names)do
  local control=child(name);control:SetVisible(not not visible[name])
  if visible[name]then
   control:SetAnchoredPosition(layout.rowOrigin[1],layout.rowOrigin[2]-row*layout.rowStep)
   row=row+1
  end
 end
 if frame.manual then child('continue'):SetAnchoredPosition(layout.continue[1],layout.continue[2])end
 local caption=child('potionReward');local position=layout.potionLabel
 caption:SetVisible(frame.pendingPotion==true)
 caption:SetAnchoredPosition(position[1],position[2]);size(caption,position[3],position[4],sizeOwner)
 frame.rewardRows=count
end
return M

-- Physical slots follow capacity; outside-combat use and discard are explicit.
local Run=require('abyss_run')
local Theme=require('abyss_theme')
local integer=require('abyss_numbers').integer
local M={}
local Controller=require('abyss_controller')
local function find(entries,id)for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do if entry.id==id then return entry end end end
local function entryFace(variant,official,mapSlots)
        if official or Theme.presentationProfile=='v25-reference' and variant:GetChild('v25MapPotionStyle') then
            for _,name in ipairs({'label','entryFace','officialButtonBacking'})do
                local control=variant:GetChild(name)
                if control then control:SetVisible(not mapSlots)end
            end
        end
end
-- Read-only shared entry paint. Keep the existing management button and its
-- binding; a slot silhouette never consumes a potion or changes selection.
local function refreshBottle(bottle,id,platform)
    bottle:SetVisible(id~=nil);if not id then return end
    bottle:SetImage(platform.imageSource,Theme.icon.potion[id] or Theme.icon.intent.unknown)
    local colour=(Theme.icon.potionTint or {})[id] or (id=='fire_potion' and Theme.color.potionShell.fire or Theme.color.potionShell.normal).ink
    bottle.imageColor=platform.color(colour.r,colour.g,colour.b,colour.a)
end
function M.refreshEntry(hit,run,platform,mapSlots)
    local capacity=run and Run.potionCapacity(run) or 0
    for _,state in ipairs({'normal','hover','pressed','disabled'})do
        local variant=hit:GetChild(state)
        local official=Theme.presentationProfile=='official-assets-first'
        entryFace(variant,official,mapSlots)
        variant:GetChild('label').text=run and '药水 '..Run.potionCount(run)..'/'..capacity or '药水'
        for i=1,Theme.layout.battlePotions.count do
            local slot=variant:GetChild('slot'..i)
            local id=i<=capacity and run.potions[i] or nil
            slot:SetVisible(mapSlots==true and i<=capacity)
            if mapSlots then
                local step=official and Theme.officialAssets.battleHud.potionStep or 42
                slot:SetAnchoredPosition((i-(capacity+1)/2)*step,0)
            end
            slot:GetChild('emptyShell'):SetVisible(id==nil)
            slot:GetChild('filledShell'):SetVisible(id~=nil and id~='fire_potion')
            slot:GetChild('fireShell'):SetVisible(id=='fire_potion')
            slot:GetChild('selectedShell'):SetVisible(false)
            refreshBottle(slot:GetChild('bottle'),id,platform)
        end
    end
end
function M.new(root,clickEvent,platform,allowed,onChange,onClose)
    local self={root=root,visible=false,generation=0}
    local function child(name)return assert(root:GetChild(name),'missing potion control '..name)end
    local function caption(name,value)
        local hit=child(name):GetChild('hit')
        for _,state in ipairs({'normal','hover','pressed','disabled'})do hit:GetChild(state):GetChild('label').text=value end
    end
    local function currentSelection()
        local s=self.selected
        return s and s.slot<=Run.potionCapacity(self.run) and self.run.potions==s.inventory and self.run.potions[s.slot]==s.id
            and self.run.phase==s.phase and self.run.combat==s.battle
    end
    local function detail(definition) local special=require('abyss_potion_text').special(definition,self.run,true);if special then return definition.name..'；'..special end
        if require('abyss_relic_hooks').owns(self.run,'sacred_bark') then
            return definition.name..'；'..require('abyss_potion_text').describe(self.run,definition.id)
        end
        if definition.description then return definition.name..'；'..definition.description end
        local result={definition.name}
        for _,effect in ipairs(definition.effects)do
            local value=integer(effect.value or 0)
            if effect.op=='damage'then result[#result+1]='对一个敌人造成 '..value..' 点伤害'
            elseif effect.op=='block'then result[#result+1]='获得 '..value..' 点格挡'
            elseif effect.op=='energy'then result[#result+1]='获得 '..value..' 点能量'
            elseif effect.status then
                local status=find(self.run.data.statuses.statuses,effect.status)
                result[#result+1]=(effect.op=='applyStatus' and '使一个敌人获得 ' or '获得 ')..value..' 层'..(status and status.name or effect.status)
            end
        end
        return table.concat(result,'；')
    end
    function self:render()
        if not self.visible then return end
        self.generation=self.generation+1
        if not currentSelection()then self.selected=nil end
        local capacity=Run.potionCapacity(self.run)
        for slot=1,Theme.layout.battlePotions.count do
            local id=self.run.potions[slot]
            local definition=id and find(self.run.data.potions.potions,id)
            child('slot'..slot):SetVisible(slot<=capacity)
            caption('slot'..slot,'槽 '..slot..'\n'..(definition and definition.name or '空槽'))
            local hit=child('slot'..slot):GetChild('hit');hit.interactable=slot<=capacity and definition~=nil;hit.raycastTarget=hit.interactable
        end
        local selected=self.selected
        child('detail').text=selected and detail(find(self.run.data.potions.potions,selected.id)) or '尚未选择药水。'
        local view=selected and Run.potionView(self.run)[selected.slot]
        local discard=child('discard'):GetChild('hit');discard.interactable=view and view.canDiscard~=false or false;discard.raycastTarget=discard.interactable
        local use=child('use'):GetChild('hit');use.interactable=self.run.phase~='combat' and view and view.canUse or false;use.raycastTarget=use.interactable
        if view and view.reason=='potion_event_restricted' then
            child('detail').text=child('detail').text..'\n此事件中不能使用或丢弃药水。'
        end
    end
    function self:open(run)
        if self.visible or not allowed(run)then return false end
        self.visible,self.run,self.selected=true,run,nil
        root:SetVisible(true);root:SetAsLastSibling();self:render();return true
    end
    function self:close()
        if not self.visible then return false end
        self.visible,self.run,self.selected=false,nil,nil
        self.generation=self.generation+1;root:SetVisible(false);return true
    end
    local function bind(name,action)
        local hit=child(name):GetChild('hit')
        local held,released,observed
        local function valid(token)
            return self.visible and allowed(self.run) and hit.interactable
                and (not token or token.run==self.run and token.generation==self.generation
                    and token.phase==self.run.phase and token.battle==self.run.combat
                    and token.inventory==self.run.potions
                    and (not token.battle or token.turn==token.battle.turn and token.battlePhase==token.battle.phase))
        end
        local cursor=platform.cursorEvents or {}
        Controller.bind(platform.controller,hit,'potions',action,function()return valid()end,name=='cancel' and 100 or 10)
        if cursor.CursorDown and cursor.CursorUp then
            hit:AddCursorEventListener(cursor.CursorDown,function(event)
                observed=true;held,released=nil,nil
                if valid()then held={run=self.run,generation=self.generation,touch=event and event.touchId,
                    phase=self.run.phase,battle=self.run.combat,inventory=self.run.potions,
                    turn=self.run.combat and self.run.combat.turn,battlePhase=self.run.combat and self.run.combat.phase}end
            end)
            hit:AddCursorEventListener(cursor.CursorUp,function(event)
                released=held and held.touch==(event and event.touchId) and valid(held) and held or nil;held=nil
            end)
            if cursor.CursorEndDrag then hit:AddCursorEventListener(cursor.CursorEndDrag,function()held,released=nil,nil end)end
        end
        hit:AddCursorEventListener(clickEvent,function(event)
            if Controller.pointerBlocked(platform.controller)then return false end
            if observed then
                local token=released;released=nil
                if not token or token.touch~=(event and event.touchId) or not valid(token)then return false end
            elseif not valid()then return false end
            return action()
        end)
    end
    for i=1,Theme.layout.battlePotions.count do
        local slot=i
        bind('slot'..slot,function()
            self.selected={slot=slot,id=self.run.potions[slot],inventory=self.run.potions,phase=self.run.phase,battle=self.run.combat}
            self:render();return true
        end)
    end
    bind('discard',function()
        if not currentSelection()then self:render();return false end
        local ok,reason=Run.discardPotion(self.run,self.selected.slot)
        self.selected=nil;self:render();if ok then onChange()end;return ok,reason
    end)
    bind('use',function()
        if not currentSelection() or self.run.phase=='combat' then self:render();return false end
        local ok,reason=Run.usePotion(self.run,self.selected.slot)
        self.selected=nil;self:render();if ok then onChange()end;return ok,reason
    end)
    bind('cancel',onClose)
    root.disableCursorEventPassthrough=true
    child('blocker'):AddCursorEventListener(clickEvent,function()return true end)
    root:SetVisible(false)
    return self
end
return M

-- Shop subview: render the Nodes quote and register actions on the node controller.
-- Transactions and gesture ownership stay with abyss_node_ui / abyss_nodes.
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local C = Theme.color
local removalInk = Theme.layout.nativeNode.shop.referenceRemovalInk or C.text
local SHOP_PAGE = #Theme.layout.nativeNode.shop.columns
local RELIC_PAGE = #Theme.layout.nativeNode.shop.relics.columns
local typeNames = { attack = "攻击", skill = "技能", power = "能力", status = "状态", curse = "诅咒" }
local rarityNames = {common='普通',uncommon='罕见',rare='稀有',shop='商店专属'}
local priceLabels = { missing = "未实装", sold = "已售出" }
local priceColors = { poor = C.danger, sold = C.textMuted }
local missingReasons = {
    card = "此商品尚未实装，不可购买", relic = "此遗物尚未实装，不可购买", potion = "此药水尚未实装，不可购买",
}
local M = {}

local function find(entries, id)
    for _, item in ipairs(entries or {}) do if item.id == id then return item end end
end

local function priceStatus(offer, poor)
    if offer.unavailable then return "missing" end
    if offer.sold then return "sold" end
    if poor then return "poor" end
    return "ok"
end

local function cardStamp(offer)
    if offer.unavailable then return "未实装" end
    if offer.sold then return "已售出" end
end

function M.new(controller, ui)
    local self = controller
    local show, state, ink, picture = ui.show, ui.state, ui.ink, ui.picture
    local fillCard, cardName = ui.fillCard, ui.cardName
    local relicName, relicText = ui.relicName, ui.relicText
    local action, commit, pageArrows = ui.action, ui.commit, ui.pageArrows
    local selection = ui.selection
    local function purchase(key, category, slot, enabled, handler, name, description, reason, attention)
        local invoke, observe = selection:bind(key, category, slot, handler, name, description, enabled, reason)
        -- Disabled goods still receive a fresh click to explain the refusal.
        -- Only enabled purchases arm a quote-owning transaction gesture.
        local inspect=selection:inspectable(category,self.run.nodeFlow[category][slot])
        return action(key, enabled or inspect, invoke, reason, attention, (enabled or inspect) and observe or nil)
    end

    local function shortfall(price)
        return "金币不足：需要 " .. number(price) .. "，还差 " .. number(price - self.run.gold)
    end

    -- Price status: ok gold, poor red, sold/missing without a coin.
    local function fillPrice(box, value, status)
        box:SetVisible(true)
        box:GetChild("value").text = priceLabels[status] or number(value)
        ink(box:GetChild("value"), priceColors[status] or C.goldBright)
        show(box:GetChild("coin"), status ~= "sold" and status ~= 'missing')
        show(box:GetChild('sale'),false)
        local price=Theme.layout.nativeNode.price
        box:GetChild('value'):SetAnchoredPosition(price.coin/2,0)
        box:GetChild('value'):SetSizeDelta(price.size[1]-price.coin-Theme.space.s,price.size[2])
    end

    local function offerState(offer, full)
        local poor = self.run.gold < offer.price
        return {
            poor = poor,
            enabled = not offer.sold and not poor and not offer.unavailable and not full,
            attention = poor and not offer.sold and not offer.unavailable and not full,
            price = priceStatus(offer, poor),
        }
    end

    local function offerNotice(kind, offer, name, full)
        if offer.unavailable then return missingReasons[kind] end
        if offer.sold then
            if kind == "potion" then return "药水已售出" end
            return "「" .. name .. "」已售出"
        end
        if full then return "药水槽已满" end
        return shortfall(offer.price)
    end

    local function potionText(id) return require('abyss_potion_text').describe(self.run,id) end

    local function writeMissingCard(box, offer)
        box:GetChild('name').text=(offer.color=='colorless' and '无色' or '')..(rarityNames[offer.rarity] or '')..'牌 · 缺口'
        box:GetChild('description').text='此类别与稀有度尚无可售内容'
        box:GetChild('cost').text=''
        box:GetChild('type').text=typeNames[offer.type] or ''
    end

    local function currentCardShelf(view, flow, shelf)
        -- A slot means the current offer, not a reusable quote. Keep this render
        -- bound to its run, node and shelf so it cannot buy Courier's replacement.
        return self.visible and self.view == view and self.renderRun == self.run and self.renderMap == self.map
            and self.run.nodeFlow == flow and flow.cards == shelf
    end

    local function bindCard(view, flow, shelf, i, offer, availability)
        local name = cardName(offer.id)
        purchase("shopView/card" .. i, 'cards', i, availability.enabled, function()
            if not currentCardShelf(view, flow, shelf) then return false, 'stale_action' end
            return commit("buyCardSlot", i, function(before)
                return "已购买「" .. name .. "」· 支付 " .. number(before.gold - self.run.gold) .. " 金币，加入牌组"
            end)
        end, name, '', offerNotice("card", offer, name), availability.attention)
    end

    local function renderCardSlot(shop, view, offers, i, flow, shelf)
        local offer = offers[(self.page - 1) * SHOP_PAGE + i]
        local box, price = shop:GetChild("card" .. i), shop:GetChild("price" .. i)
        show(box, offer ~= nil) show(price, offer ~= nil)
        if not offer then return end
        local availability = offerState(offer)
        fillCard(box, offer.id, offer.upgraded==true, { dim = offer.sold or availability.poor or offer.unavailable,
            veil = offer.sold, stamp = cardStamp(offer), reason = cardStamp(offer) or availability.poor and '金币不足' or nil, selected = selection:isSelected('shopView/card' .. i) })
        if offer.unavailable then writeMissingCard(box, offer) end
        fillPrice(price, offer.price, availability.price)
        if offer.sale and not offer.sold and not offer.unavailable then
            local frame=Theme.layout.nativeNode.price.saleValue
            show(price:GetChild('sale'),true)
            price:GetChild('value'):SetAnchoredPosition(frame[1],frame[2])
            price:GetChild('value'):SetSizeDelta(frame[3],frame[4])
        end
        bindCard(view, flow, shelf, i, offer, availability)
    end

    local function renderCards(shop, view, offers)
        local flow, shelf = self.run.nodeFlow, self.run.nodeFlow.cards
        for i = 1, SHOP_PAGE do
            renderCardSlot(shop, view, offers, i, flow, shelf)
        end
        pageArrows(shop, "", self.page, self.pageCount)
        action("shopView/previous", self.page > 1, function() return self:setPage(self.page - 1) end)
        action("shopView/next", self.page < self.pageCount, function() return self:setPage(self.page + 1) end)
        shop:GetChild("page").text = ''
    end

    local function removalReason(node)
        if not node.removeAvailable then return "本店删牌服务已使用，每家商店限一次" end
        if #node.purgeCards == 0 then return "没有可移除的卡牌" end
        return shortfall(node.removePrice)
    end

    local function removalDescription(node)
        if not node.removeAvailable then return "本店已使用" end
        if #node.purgeCards == 0 then return "没有可移除的卡牌" end
        return "每家商店限一次\n之后的商店 +" .. self.run.data.rules.shop.removeCardIncrement
    end

    local function renderRemovalPrice(removalPrice, node, poor)
        fillPrice(removalPrice, node.removePrice, not node.removeAvailable and "sold" or poor and "poor" or "ok")
        if not node.removeAvailable then removalPrice:GetChild("value").text = "已使用" end
    end

    local function renderRemoval(shop, node)
        local removal, removalPrice = shop:GetChild("removal"), shop:GetChild("removalPrice")
        local poor = node.removeAvailable and self.run.gold < node.removePrice
        local open = node.removeAvailable and #node.purgeCards > 0 and not poor
        local reason = removalReason(node)
        state(removal, open)
        if Theme.layout.nativeNode.shop.referenceRemovalName then removal:GetChild('name').text=Theme.layout.nativeNode.shop.referenceRemovalName end
        removal:GetChild("description").text = removalDescription(node)
        ink(removal:GetChild("name"), open and removalInk or C.textMuted)
        renderRemovalPrice(removalPrice, node, poor)
        action("shopView/removal", open, function()
            self.mode, self.picker, self.pickPage, self.selected, self.notice = "picker", "remove", 1, nil, ""
            self:render() return true
        end, reason, poor)
    end

    local function relicTitle(offer)
        if offer.unavailable then return (rarityNames[offer.rarity] or '') .. '遗物' end
        return relicName(offer.id) .. (offer.sold and " · 已售出" or "")
    end

    local function writeRelic(tile, offer, availability)
        state(tile, availability.enabled or selection:inspectable('relics',offer))
        picture(tile:GetChild("icon"), Theme.icon.relic[offer.id])
        if ui.relicPicture then ui.relicPicture(tile:GetChild('icon'),offer.id,Theme.layout.nativeNode.shop.relics.disc)end
        tile:GetChild("name").text = relicTitle(offer)
        tile:GetChild("description").text = offer.unavailable and '此稀有度暂无可售内容' or relicText(offer.id)
        ink(tile:GetChild("name"), (offer.sold or availability.poor) and C.textMuted or C.text)
        show(tile:GetChild("veil"), offer.sold)
    end

    local function bindRelic(i, offer, availability)
        local name = relicName(offer.id)
        purchase("shopView/relic" .. i, 'relics', i, availability.enabled, function()
            return commit("buyRelic", offer.id, function(before)
                return "已购买遗物「" .. name .. "」· 支付 " .. number(before.gold - self.run.gold) .. " 金币"
            end)
        end, name, relicText(offer.id), offerNotice("relic", offer, name), availability.attention)
    end

    local function renderRelicSlot(shop, offers, i)
        local offer = offers[(self.relicPage - 1) * RELIC_PAGE + i]
        local tile, price = shop:GetChild("relic" .. i), shop:GetChild("relicPrice" .. i)
        show(tile, offer ~= nil) show(price, offer ~= nil)
        if not offer then return end
        local availability = offerState(offer)
        writeRelic(tile, offer, availability)
        fillPrice(price, offer.price, availability.price)
        bindRelic(i, offer, availability)
    end

    local function renderRelics(shop, offers)
        local relicPages = 1
        for i = 1, RELIC_PAGE do
            renderRelicSlot(shop, offers, i)
        end
        pageArrows(shop, "relic", self.relicPage, relicPages)
        action("shopView/relicPrevious", self.relicPage > 1, function()
            self.relicPage, self.notice = self.relicPage - 1, "" self:render() return true end)
        action("shopView/relicNext", self.relicPage < relicPages, function()
            self.relicPage, self.notice = self.relicPage + 1, "" self:render() return true end)
    end

    local function potionDescription(offer, full)
        if offer.unavailable then return '此稀有度暂无可售内容' end
        if offer.sold then return '已售出' end
        if full then return '药水槽已满' end
        return potionText(offer.id)
    end

    local function writePotion(tile, offer, definition, availability, full)
        state(tile, availability.enabled or selection:inspectable('potions',offer))
        picture(tile:GetChild('icon'), Theme.icon.potion[offer.id])
        tile:GetChild('name').text = definition and definition.name or (rarityNames[offer.rarity] or '') .. '药水'
        tile:GetChild('description').text = potionDescription(offer, full)
        show(tile:GetChild('veil'), offer.sold)
    end

    local function bindPotion(i, offer, availability, full)
        local definition = find(self.run.data.potions.potions, offer.id)
        purchase('shopView/potion' .. i, 'potions', i, availability.enabled, function()
            return commit('buyPotion', i, function(before)
                return '已购买药水 · 支付 ' .. number(before.gold - self.run.gold) .. ' 金币'
            end)
        end, definition and definition.name or '', potionText(offer.id), offerNotice("potion", offer, nil, full), availability.attention)
    end

    local function renderPotionSlot(shop, i, offer)
        local tile, price = shop:GetChild('potion' .. i), shop:GetChild('potionPrice' .. i)
        local definition = find(self.run.data.potions.potions, offer.id)
        local full = Run.potionCount(self.run) >= Run.potionCapacity(self.run)
        local availability = offerState(offer, full)
        writePotion(tile, offer, definition, availability, full)
        fillPrice(price, offer.price, availability.price)
        bindPotion(i, offer, availability, full)
    end

    local function renderPotions(shop, offers)
        for i, offer in ipairs(offers) do renderPotionSlot(shop, i, offer) end
    end

    return function(view, node)
        local shop = ui.child("shopView")
        selection:begin()
        self.pageCount, self.page, self.relicPage = 1, 1, 1
        renderCards(shop, view, node.cards or {})
        renderRemoval(shop, node)
        renderRelics(shop, node.relics or {})
        renderPotions(shop, node.potions or {})
        selection:paint(0)
        return ''
    end
end

return M

-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Actors = require("abyss_actor")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local EnemyView = require('abyss_battle_enemy_view')
local DamageView = require('abyss_battle_damage_view')
local PotionView = require("abyss_battle_potion_view")
local IntentView = require("abyss_battle_intent_view")
local RewardOwner = require("abyss_battle_reward_owner")
local LowCostArt=require('abyss_lowcost_art')
local M = {}
local C, L, S = Theme.color, Theme.layout, Theme.space
local number = require("abyss_numbers").integer
local potionText = PotionView.potionText
local intentView = IntentView.intentView
-- Last successful geometry writer per native handle; tokens hold no view references.
local intentSizes=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
local intentPositions=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
local function intentSize(control,width,height,owner)
    local painted=intentSizes[control]
    if painted and painted.owner==owner and painted.width==width
        and painted.height==height and control.alive~=false then return end
    -- Revoke the old promise before a setter can partially apply or re-enter.
    local pending={};intentSizes[control]=pending
    local ok,result=pcall(control.SetSizeDelta,control,width,height)
    local current=intentSizes[control]==pending
    intentSizes[control]=nil
    if not ok then error(result,0) end
    if result~=false and current then intentSizes[control]={owner=owner,width=width,height=height} end
end
local function intentPosition(control,x,y,owner)
    local painted=intentPositions[control]
    if painted and painted.owner==owner and painted.x==x
        and painted.y==y and control.alive~=false then return end
    local pending={};intentPositions[control]=pending
    local ok,result=pcall(control.SetAnchoredPosition,control,x,y)
    local current=intentPositions[control]==pending
    intentPositions[control]=nil
    if not ok then error(result,0) end
    -- Overlapping native setters have unknown completion order: retry next time.
    if result~=false and current then intentPositions[control]={owner=owner,x=x,y=y} end
end
-- Only the six intent controls have exclusive visibility writers in this module.
-- Name visibility is also owned by UnitView, so it is deliberately not cached.
local intentVisibilities=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
local function intentVisible(control,value,binding)
    local saved=intentVisibilities[control]
    if saved and saved.binding==binding and saved.value==value and control.alive~=false then return end
    local pending={};intentVisibilities[control]=pending
    local ok,accepted=pcall(control.SetVisible,control,value)
    local ownsWrite=intentVisibilities[control]==pending
    intentVisibilities[control]=nil
    if not ok then error(accepted,0) end
    if accepted~=false and ownsWrite then intentVisibilities[control]={binding=binding,value=value} end
end
local function needsTarget(state, instance)
    -- Ask the core to validate the same card with and without a target.
    local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(state, instance.uid, nil)
    return reason == "invalid_target"
end
local function aimsAtAllEnemies(battle,uid)
    for _,instance in ipairs(battle.hand) do
        if instance.uid==uid then return Combat.cardDefinition(battle,instance).target=='ALL_ENEMY' end
    end
    return false
end
local function enemyPortraitIcon(enemy)
    return Theme.icon.enemy[enemy.definitionId] or Theme.icon.node[enemy.tier == 'normal' and 'combat' or enemy.tier]
end
local function paintEnemyArt(host,box,enemy,x,y,portrait,tone,dim)
    local icon=box:GetChild('portrait')
    if host.monsterArt:write(box,x,y,portrait,tone)then LowCostArt.hide(icon,false);return end
    LowCostArt.paint(icon,'enemy',enemy.definitionId,portrait,host.platform)
    LowCostArt.dim(icon,dim and .4 or 1)
    LowCostArt.refresh(box,{r=tone.r,g=tone.g,b=tone.b,a=255})
end
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, ownership, host, dependencies)
    -- A new view binding starts fresh; weak native keys cannot retain retired actors.
    local intentGeometryOwner={}
    local intentImages=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local intentTexts=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local potionCaptions=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local function intentPicture(control,id)
        local image=type(id)=='table' and id.id or id
        local source=host.platform.imageSource
        local painted=intentImages[control]
        if painted and painted.image==image and painted.source==source and control.alive~=false then return end
        intentImages[control]=nil
        if dependencies.picture(control,id)~=false then intentImages[control]={image=image,source=source} end
    end
    local function pendingCardTarget(frame)
        if not frame.fighting or not owner.selected then return false end
        for _, instance in ipairs(frame.battle.hand) do
            if instance.uid == owner.selected then return needsTarget(frame.battle, instance) end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function potionHighlighted(enemy, index, pendingTarget)
        local aim = owner.potionAim
        if not aim or pendingTarget or not Actors.isActive(enemy) then return false end
        if aim.moving then
            local valid, hovered = dependencies.potionDragTarget(aim)
            return valid and hovered == index
        end
        -- Point selection advertises every legal enemy; a moving bottle locks
        -- only the hovered target through potionDragTarget above.
        return true
    end
    local function enemyHighlighted(frame, enemy, index, pendingTarget)
        local targetable = frame.active and pendingTarget and Combat.canPlay(frame.battle, owner.selected, index)
        if owner.gesture and owner.gesture.moving then
            local valid, hovered = dependencies.dragTarget(owner.gesture)
            targetable = valid and hovered == index
        end
        return targetable == true or potionHighlighted(enemy,index,pendingTarget) or owner.acting == enemy.id
    end
    local function enemyIntentFace(frame,enemy,index)
        local face
        if IntentView.hasSourceIntent(enemy)then
            local view=host.monsterIntentParticles
            local selected=view:needsSelected(enemy.id) and IntentView.selectedDescriptor(frame.battle,index) or nil
            face=view:face(enemy.id,selected,function(base)
                return Combat.intentAttackAmount(frame.battle,enemy,frame.battle.player,base)
            end)
        else face=intentView(frame.battle,index)end
        -- Dome changes visibility, never the source selected/displayed state.
        if require('abyss_boss_relics').hidesIntents(owner.run)then face.hidden=true;face.value=''end
        return face
    end
    local function intentGeometry(portrait,geometry)
        if geometry then return geometry.intentX,geometry.intentY,geometry.intentWidth end
        return 0,portrait/2,128*Theme.canvas.base[1]/1920
    end
    local function intentTone(alpha,kind)
        -- STS intent atlases are colour-coded (attack red, defend blue, buff gold,
        -- debuff violet); white-tinted silhouettes read as one undifferentiated blob.
        local ink=({attack=C.danger,defend=C.block,buff=C.buff,debuff=C.debuff,strong_debuff=C.debuff})[kind] or C.text
        return {r=ink.r,g=ink.g,b=ink.b,a=255*(alpha or 1)}
    end
    local function renderIntentIcon(box,face,x,y,size,allowed,alpha)
        local kind=face.worldKind or face.kind
        local visible=allowed~=false and (face.sourceEnum and face.worldVisible or not face.sourceEnum)
        local icon=box:GetChild('intentIcon');intentVisible(icon,visible==true,intentGeometryOwner)
        -- STS 128px intent frames are mostly transparent padding; the official glyphs here
        -- are full-bleed, so draw them at the glyph size and float them clear of the head.
        local glyph=math.min(size,L.intent.size)
        intentSize(icon,glyph,glyph,intentGeometryOwner);intentPosition(icon,x,y,intentGeometryOwner)
        if visible then
            intentPicture(icon,Theme.icon.intent[kind] or Theme.icon.intent.unknown)
            dependencies.tint(icon,intentTone(alpha,kind))
        end
    end
    local function renderIntentValue(box,face,x,y,allowed,alpha)
        local kind=face.worldKind or face.kind
        local value=box:GetChild('intent')
        local attack=face.sourceEnum and face.sourceEnum:sub(1,6)=='ATTACK' or not face.sourceEnum and kind=='attack'
        intentVisible(value,allowed~=false and attack and face.value~='',intentGeometryOwner)
        local text=face.value and face.value:gsub('×','x') or ''
        if intentTexts[value]~=text or value.alive==false then
            intentTexts[value]=nil
            value.text=text
            intentTexts[value]=text
        end
        local width=math.max(L.intent.valueWidth,utf8.len(text)*L.intent.numberSize)
        intentSize(value,width,L.nativeText.lineHeight,intentGeometryOwner)
        intentPosition(value,x+L.intent.size/2+S.xs+width/2,y,intentGeometryOwner)
        dependencies.ink(value,intentTone(alpha))
    end
    local function renderEnemyIntent(box,face,portrait,geometry,allowed,alpha)
        local x,y,size=intentGeometry(portrait,geometry)
        renderIntentIcon(box,face,x,y,size,allowed,alpha)
        for _,name in ipairs({'intentBadge','intentExtra','intentLabel'})do intentVisible(box:GetChild(name),false,intentGeometryOwner)end
        renderIntentValue(box,face,x,y,allowed,alpha)
        local sx,sy=Theme.canvas.base[1]/1920,Theme.canvas.base[2]/1080
        local hit=box:GetChild('intentHit');intentVisible(hit,allowed~=false,intentGeometryOwner)
        intentPosition(hit,x,y,intentGeometryOwner);intentSize(hit,64*sx,64*sy,intentGeometryOwner)
    end
    local function enemyIntentAllowed(actor,battle)
        return not require('abyss_boss_relics').hidesIntents(owner.run) and Actors.isPresent(actor) and not owner.feedback.dying[actor.id]
            and not owner.feedback.escaping[actor.id] and battle.player.hp>0
    end
    local function enemyAimProjection(frame)
        local aimed = owner.gesture or owner.carry
        local projection = { pendingTarget = pendingCardTarget(frame) }
        if aimed and aimed.moving then projection.valid, projection.target = dependencies.dragTarget(aimed) end
        -- Original targeting updates card damage, not future enemy HP. Keep the
        -- legacy preview outside this profile; cloning and playing a detached
        -- battle on pointer input is both unnecessary and expensive here.
        local futureHp = Theme.presentationProfile ~= 'official-assets-first'
        if projection.valid and not futureHp then projection.allEnemies=aimsAtAllEnemies(frame.battle,aimed.uid) end
        if projection.valid and futureHp then projection.losses = DamageView.preview(frame.battle, aimed.uid, projection.target) end
        local potion=owner.potionAim
        if potion and potion.moving then
            projection.valid,projection.target=dependencies.potionDragTarget(potion)
            if projection.valid and futureHp then projection.losses=DamageView.potionPreview(owner.run,potion.slot,projection.target) end
        end
        return projection
    end
    local function renderDamagePreview(box, enemy, portrait, width, loss)
        local preview = box:GetChild('damagePreview')
        preview:SetVisible(loss ~= nil and loss.loss > 0)
        preview:SetAnchoredPosition(0, -portrait / 2 - S.xxl + L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        preview:SetSizeDelta(width, L.nativeText.lineHeight)
        preview.text = loss and loss.loss > 0 and (loss.hp <= 0 and '击杀' or '−' .. number(loss.loss)) or ''
        if loss and loss.loss > 0 then box:GetChild('hpFill').fillAmount = math.max(0, loss.hp / enemy.maxHp) end
    end
    local function renderEnemySlot(frame, box, entry, slot, count, aim)
        local enemy = entry.actor
        local x, width, portrait, step, y = dependencies.enemySlot(count, slot, enemy)
        box:SetAnchoredPosition(x, y)
        local selected = enemyHighlighted(frame, enemy, entry.index, aim.pendingTarget)
            or aim.allEnemies==true and Actors.isActive(enemy)
        local loss = aim.losses and aim.losses[entry.index]
        if aim.valid and not aim.target and loss and loss.loss > 0 then selected = true end
        local geometry=EnemyView.geometry(enemy)
        host.unit(box, enemy, portrait, enemyPortraitIcon(enemy), width, selected,step,geometry)
        host.monsterPowers:render(box,entry.controlSlot,enemy,geometry)
        box:GetChild('hit'):SetSizeDelta(geometry.hitWidth,geometry.hitHeight)
        box:GetChild('hit'):SetAnchoredPosition(geometry.hitX-x,geometry.hitY-y)
        local dim = (aim.pendingTarget or owner.potionAim ~= nil) and not selected
        local portraitTone = C.text
        local tone={r=portraitTone.r,g=portraitTone.g,b=portraitTone.b,a=dim and 102 or 255}
        dependencies.tint(box:GetChild('portrait'),tone)
        paintEnemyArt(host,box,enemy,x,y,portrait,tone,dim)
        renderDamagePreview(box, enemy, portrait, width, loss)
        renderEnemyIntent(box, enemyIntentFace(frame, enemy, entry.index), portrait,geometry,
            enemyIntentAllowed(enemy,frame.battle),host.monsterIntentParticles:alpha(enemy.id))
        host.monsterIntentParticles:paint(box,enemy.id,geometry,enemyIntentAllowed(enemy,frame.battle))
    end
    local function updateEnemyIntents(dt)
        local battle=owner.displayBattle or owner.run and owner.run.combat
        if not battle or not owner.active then return end
        -- The surface manager owns live handles. Feedback rows may still include
        -- a death whose independently clocked surface has already retired.
        for _,entry in ipairs(owner.feedback.enemyRows or {})do
            local actor=entry.actor
            local box=host.monsterSurfaces:find(entry.id)
            if box then
            local face=enemyIntentFace({battle=battle,enemyPlayback=owner.feedback.busy},actor,entry.index)
            local g=EnemyView.geometry(actor)
            local dying,escaping=owner.feedback.dying[entry.id],owner.feedback.escaping[entry.id]
            host.monsterIntentParticles:update(entry.id,dt,face,g,dying,escaping)
            renderEnemyIntent(box,face,g.portrait,g,enemyIntentAllowed(actor,battle),
                host.monsterIntentParticles:alpha(entry.id))
            host.monsterIntentParticles:paint(box,entry.id,g,enemyIntentAllowed(actor,battle) and face.sourceEnum~='NONE')
            else
                assert(not Actors.isPresent(actor),'active monster intent surface missing: '..entry.id)
            end
        end
    end
    local function nameBlocked(actor)
        if owner.feedback.dying[actor.id] or owner.feedback.escaping[actor.id] then return true end
        if not owner.gesture then return false end
        local battle=owner.run and owner.run.combat
        for _,card in ipairs(battle and battle.hand or {})do
            if card.uid==owner.selected then return not needsTarget(battle,card)end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function updateEnemyNames(dt)
        local battle=owner.run and owner.run.combat
        if ownership.nameBattle~=battle or not ownership.nameStates then ownership.nameBattle=battle;ownership.nameStates={}end
        local x,y
        if host.platform.cursorPosition then x,y=dependencies.point({GetUIPos=host.platform.cursorPosition})end
        local wanted={}
        host.monsterSurfaces:each(function(box,_,entry)
            local id,actor=entry.id,entry.actor;wanted[id]=true
            local state=ownership.nameStates[id] or {timer=0,alpha=0}
            ownership.nameStates[id]=state
            local g=EnemyView.geometry(actor)
            local hovered=x and y and math.abs(x-g.hitX)<g.hitWidth/2 and math.abs(y-g.hitY)<g.hitHeight/2
            local offset
            state.timer,state.alpha,offset=EnemyView.nameStep(state.timer,state.alpha,dt,hovered,nameBlocked(actor),1)
            local name=box:GetChild('name');name:SetVisible(owner.active and offset~=nil and state.alpha>0)
            if offset then
                name:SetAnchoredPosition(g.nameX-(box:GetChild('portrait').x or 0),g.nameY+offset*g.sourceScale)
                dependencies.ink(name,{r=C.gold.r,g=C.gold.g,b=C.gold.b,a=math.floor(255*state.alpha)})
            end
        end)
        for id in pairs(ownership.nameStates)do if not wanted[id]then ownership.nameStates[id]=nil end end
    end
    local function hideEscapingHud(box,id)
        if not owner.feedback.escaping[id] then return end
        for _,name in ipairs({'hpBorder','hpTrack','hpGhost','hpFill','hp','blockEdge','blockIcon','block','name','statusRow','intentIcon','intentBadge','intentExtra','intent','intentHit'})do
            local control=box:GetChild(name)
            intentVisibilities[control]=nil
            local ok,why=pcall(control.SetVisible,control,false)
            intentVisibilities[control]=nil
            if not ok then error(why,0) end
        end
    end
    local function suspendEnemies(rows)
        local ok,why=pcall(function()
            host.monsterSurfaces:select(rows,owner.run.combat)
            host.monsterArt:select(rows)
            host.monsterSurfaces:each(function(box)
                assert(box:SetVisible(false)~=false,'suspended monster visibility rejected')
                host.monsterIntentParticles:release(box)
            end)
        end)
        if not ok then
            local cleaned,reason=pcall(owner.releaseMonsterSurfaces,owner)
            error(tostring(why)..(cleaned and '' or '; cleanup: '..tostring(reason)))
        end
    end
    local function canSuspendEnemies(frame)
        return not owner.active and frame.fighting and owner.run and owner.run.phase=='combat'
            and owner.suspendedBattle==owner.run.combat and host.monsterSurfaces.battle==owner.run.combat
    end
    local function renderEnemies(frame)
        local rows = frame.fighting and EnemyView.slots(frame.battle, owner.feedback) or {}
        local suspended=canSuspendEnemies(frame)
        local retained=rows
        if not owner.active then rows={}end
        host.monsterIntentParticles:sync(rows,owner.run and owner.run.combat,owner.feedback.current,owner.active and frame.fighting)
        if suspended then owner.feedback.enemyRows={};suspendEnemies(retained);return end
        host.monsterSurfaces:select(rows,owner.run and owner.run.combat)
        owner.feedback.enemyRows = rows
        local aim = enemyAimProjection(frame)
        for _,entry in ipairs(rows)do owner.feedback.bindEnemySlot(entry.controlSlot,entry.id)end
        host.monsterArt:select(rows)
        for index,entry in ipairs(rows)do
            local box=assert(host.monsterSurfaces:find(entry.id))
            renderEnemySlot(frame,box,entry,index,#rows,aim)
            hideEscapingHud(box,entry.id)
            box:SetVisible(true)
        end
        updateEnemyNames(0)
    end
    local function renderDetails(frame)
        local reward=owner.info and owner.info.reward and RewardOwner.ready(owner,owner.info.reward)
        if owner.info and (not owner.active or owner.busy or owner.gesture or not frame.fighting and not reward
            or owner.info.battle ~= frame.run.combat) then owner.info = nil end
        host.renderInfo(frame.battle or reward and frame.run.combat)
    end
    local function renderRewardActions(frame)
        local run, stolen = frame.run, frame.stolen
        dependencies.button("skip", owner.active and frame.picking == true and not run.rewards.cardResolved and not owner.busy, false, "跳过")
        dependencies.button("stolenGold", owner.active and stolen and not stolen.claimed and not owner.busy, false,
            stolen and (stolen.claimed and "已取回失金 " or "取回失金 ") .. number(stolen.amount) or "取回失金")
    end
    local function renderContinue(frame)
        local run = frame.run
        dependencies.button("continue", owner.active and run and (frame.manual or run.phase == "map") and not owner.busy, true,
            frame.manual and "前往地图" or "再战一场")
    end
    local function bindPotionSlots(frame)
        if frame.fighting and not owner.busy then
            owner.potionBattle, owner.potionRun, owner.potionSlots = frame.battle, frame.run, {}
            for slot = 1, frame.potionCapacity do
                local id = frame.run.potions[slot]
                if id then owner.potionSlots[slot] = {slot = slot, id = id} end
            end
        end
    end
    local function boundPotion(frame, index)
        local binding = owner.potionSlots and owner.potionSlots[index]
        local item = binding and frame.potions[binding.slot]
        if item and item.id ~= binding.id then return nil end
        return item
    end
    local function potionSelected(slot)
        return owner.potionMenu and owner.potionMenu.slot==slot
            or owner.potionAim and owner.potionAim.slot==slot
    end
    local function paintPotionContents(face,item,tones)
        local bottle=face:GetChild('bottle');bottle:SetVisible(item~=nil)
        face:GetChild('label'):SetVisible(false)
        if item then
            dependencies.picture(bottle,Theme.icon.potion[item.id] or Theme.icon.intent.unknown)
            dependencies.tint(bottle,(Theme.icon.potionTint or {})[item.id]
                or (item.id=='fire_potion' and tones.fire.ink or tones.normal.ink))
            LowCostArt.paint(bottle,'potion',item.id,L.battlePotions.bottleSize,host.platform)
        else LowCostArt.hide(bottle,false) end
    end
    local function paintPotionShell(slot,item)
        local selected=item~=nil and potionSelected(slot)==true
        local tones=C.potionShell
        for _,state in ipairs({'normal','hover','pressed','disabled'})do
            local face=dependencies.child('potion'..slot):GetChild(state)
            face:GetChild('emptyShell'):SetVisible(item==nil)
            face:GetChild('filledShell'):SetVisible(item~=nil and item.id~='fire_potion')
            face:GetChild('fireShell'):SetVisible(item~=nil and item.id=='fire_potion')
            face:GetChild('selectedShell'):SetVisible(selected)
            dependencies.tint(face:GetChild('filledShell'):GetChild('rim'),selected and tones.selected.border or tones.normal.border)
            dependencies.tint(face:GetChild('fireShell'):GetChild('rim'),selected and tones.selected.border or tones.fire.border)
            paintPotionContents(face,item,tones)
        end
    end
    local function paintPotionCaption(slot,item,visible)
        local caption=dependencies.child('potionCaption'..slot)
        local original=Theme.presentationProfile=='official-assets-first'
        local shown=not original and visible==true and item~=nil
        local text=not original and item and PotionView.slotLabel(item)or ''
        local prior=potionCaptions[caption]
        if not prior or prior.shown~=shown or prior.text~=text then
            potionCaptions[caption]=nil
            local accepted=true
            if not prior or prior.shown~=shown then accepted=caption:SetVisible(shown)~=false end

local integer=require('abyss_numbers').integer

local function find(entries,id)for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do if entry.id==id then return entry end end end
local function entryFace(variant,official,mapSlots)
